units: cord AMOUNTS are INTERFACE units (+-100), as returned by the editor SysEx parameter interface. E4B FILE bytes are +-127. To compare a file byte against these: interface = round(file * 100/127). Verified on three cords: file 92 -> 72, file -12 -> -9, file 67 -> 53, all exact.
sign_convention: the sign is preserved but its meaning is UNMEASURED -- +72 and -9 pan in opposite senses, but which sign is which side has not been determined on hardware. Do not assume.
voice_caveat: voice indices past a preset's real voice count return plausible values rather than failing; treat high-index rows as unverified
